description: The foe is attacked with ultimate cold that causes fainting if it hits.

name: Bullet Seed
description: The user shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot at once.

name: Aerial Ace
description: An extremely fast attack against one target. It can't be evaded.

name: Icicle Spear
description: Sharp icicles are fired at the foe. It strikes two to five times.

name: Block
description: The user blocks the foe's way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.

name: Howl
description: The user howls to raise its spirit and boost its ATTACK stat.

name: Dragon Claw
description: Sharp, huge claws hook and slash the foe quickly and with great power.

name: Frenzy Plant
description: The foe is hit with an enormous branch. The user can't move on the next turn.

name: Bulk Up
description: The user bulks up its body to boost both its ATTACK and DEFENSE stats.

name: Bounce
description: The user bounces on the foe on the 2nd turn. It may paralyze the foe.

name: Mud Shot
description: The user attacks by hurling mud. It also reduces the foe's SPEED.

name: Covet
description: A cutely executed attack that also steals the foe's hold item.

name: Magical Leaf
description: The foe is attacked with a strange leaf that cannot be evaded.

name: Water Sport
description: Weakens FIRE-type attacks while the user is in the battle.

name: Calm Mind
description: The user focuses its mind to raise the SP. ATK and SP. DEF stats.

name: Dragon Dance
description: A mystic, powerful dance that boosts the user's ATTACK and SPEED stats.

name: Rock Blast
description: The user hurls two to five hard rocks at the foe to attack.

name: Shock Wave
description: A rapid jolt of electricity strikes the foe. It can't be evaded.

name: Water Pulse
description: An attack with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.
